meta.description: TrondheimDC is the association behind the TDC conference. It supports the volunteer-run tech community in the Trondheim region.

hero.title: TrondheimDC
hero.subtitle: We run the TDC conference. The surplus goes to next year's conference and to supporting Trondheim's volunteer tech community.

about.title: What we do
about.p1: TDC is organised by a cross-section of the tech communities in the Trondheim region. The goal is a non-commercial, volunteer-run conference where tech enthusiasts can meet, share knowledge, and learn from each other.
about.p2: Any surplus from the conference goes to next year's conference and to events that Trondheim's tech communities hold during the year. Our bylaws commit the association to funding the local, volunteer-run tech community.
about.p3: We've been running the conference since 2012.

groups.title: Communities in Trondheim
groups.subtitle: An overview of the tech communities in the Trondheim region, not just the ones we fund.

addYours.title: Is your community missing?
addYours.body: Email us and we'll add you to the list.

communityStand.title: Community stand
communityStand.intro: TDC is a conference by and for the tech community in Trondheim. But a community needs more than one day a year to stay alive, and it's the city's user groups that keep it going between conferences.
communityStand.offer: So the committee sets aside a large shared stand for the user groups at the conference on {{date}}. It's a chance for the groups to meet the attendees and show off the breadth of the city's tech scene.
get: A spot on the shared stand, alongside the other user groups.
One full stand ticket, including the talks, lunch, and the after party.
Free rein on the stand. Banners, competitions, a bowl of sweets: it's up to you.
expect: That someone is at the stand during the breaks.
That you tell us which of you gets the stand ticket.
communityStand.signup: Email us the name and email address of whoever gets the stand ticket, and we'll take it from there.
communityStand.groupsBody: The offer is for user groups in the Trondheim region. See who's already listed.

stotte.title: Support for communities
stotte.intro: The association exists to support the local, volunteer-run tech community in the Trondheim region. Here's who can apply and what we can cover.
criteria: The event must take place in the Trondheim region.
The event must be free and open to anyone who wants to attend.
The event must clearly focus on technology, design, or creativity, and be relevant to the TDC community.
stotte.closing: Email us and we'll work it out together. Tell us briefly about the event: the theme, the audience, and what you'd like us to cover.
stotte.reimburseBody: Use our expense form to get your money back.
